name: io.github.skiplink/mcp
title: Skiplink
description: Explain axe-core accessibility rules, read a project's baseline, and scan a URL for WCAG violations.

environmentVariables.name: SKIPLINK_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Skiplink API key. Only the scan_url tool needs it; the other four work without one.

environmentVariables.name: SKIPLINK_API
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://api.skiplink.dev.
